summary_en: Tsukada Global Holdings authorized the acquisition of up to 1,000,000 shares (2.13% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥600 million via open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 17, 2026 and January 29, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Tsukada Global Holdings announced a treasury stock acquisition program authorized by its board of directors. The company will acquire up to 1,000,000 shares of its common stock, representing 2.13% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥600 million.

The acquisition will be executed through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with purchases to occur between November 17, 2026 and January 29, 2027. At the time of the announcement, the company held 1,916,234 shares of treasury stock, with 47,043,766 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.

The company stated that the share buyback is designed to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, identifying these objectives as core priorities for management. The acquisition will be conducted under the company's articles of incorporation pursuant to Article 165(2) and (3) of the Companies Act.
